name: Gaon Ki Beti
benefit:
1. Each year, girls who pass the 12th standard with first-class marks from a village will be eligible.
1. Selected students will receive a scholarship of ₹500/- per month.
1. The scholarship will be provided for a maximum of 10 months per year.
_eligibility_text: 1. The student must have secured 60% or more marks in the 12th standard. 1. The girl must reside in a rural area and possess a "Gaon Ki Beti" (Daughter of the Village) certificate. 1. She must be enrolled in a recognized institution for higher education.
